missionEventData.data2: Fresh from their stunning success against the Invincible, the Alliance has found renewed hope in their struggle against the Empire. Joined by new allies from Sullust and Mon Calamari, Ace pilot Keyan Farlander and the Rebel Alliance must now continue the fight. But rumour has it that the Empire has a secret project of such awesome destructive power that it could destroy not only the Alliance but resistance itself.

missionEventData.data1: Welcome back pilots. Our escapees brought information on a series of Imperial convoys en route to an unknown project worksite. The convoys are numerous and large and High Command thinks it would be wise if they experienced a few "unscheduled problems". For our first target we’ve chosen an imperial workforce convoy, or to be more accurate a slave convoy. Slave convoys are typically poorly defended, a reflection of the value that the Empire puts on them. So this should be relatively easy. Red Squadron will drop in and destroy any fighter support after which the Bixby will jump in to take control of the vessels. Best of luck.
This is Red Leader. All ships accounted for...
Proceed with the flightplan, and good luck.
Star Wings! Red Squadron break and engage now!
Red Lead this is six! That convoy is packing a lot more firepower than we expected.
Acknowledged Six. Signal Command and request mission abort.
What do we do in the mean time?
Ah, six did you get through to command?
Ship exiting hyperspace. It's the Intrepid.
Command acknowledges mission abort. But the Bixby is already en route. They want us to cover it's exit.
Bixby! Command has signalled mission abort. We'll cover you while you return to the jump point.
Acknowledged Red Lead. Already on our way out.
The Bixby is out. Time to go.
That was close! No one expected the convoy to be packing that kind of fire power, and the speed with which the Intrepid responded suggests this project could be more important than we thought…
Okay, Red Squadron, we just need to hold it together a little longer.
